presentation.guidance: Topic product architecture opens with problem-domain analytical prose; direction is named at milestone granularity without mixing boundaries, capability layout, or feature-level outcomes.

allowed.carrier: Causal analytical prose (trigger → current situation → cost of unresolved uncertainty → named topic direction)

forbidden: Scope or exclusion tables (belongs in BD)
Capability or journey diagrams (belongs in PS)
Decision comparison tables (belongs in PR)
Open-question tracking tables (belongs in OQ)
Feature user-story tables (belongs in lulu-spec)

required: States why product shaping happens now and what the current product situation is
Names an observable topic-level product direction without feature backlog or technical detail
forbidden: Opening paragraphs that lead with repository or implementation inventories
Checkbox steps, technical module names, or acceptance criteria

presentation.guidance: Boundaries express shaping scope for a multi-feature topic: in-scope capability domains, excluded product paths, and cross-feature invariants.

allowed.carrier: Scope table (capability domain or user segment | shaping concern in scope)
Exclusion list (excluded product path | protected boundary/invariant)

forbidden: Feature backlog tables (belongs in lulu-spec)
Capability dependency diagrams (belongs in PS)
Trade-off reasoning with adopted/rejected paths (belongs in PR)
Open-assumption tracking (belongs in OQ)

required: Scope, exclusions, and invariants are distinguishable and non-contradictory
Each exclusion identifies the boundary or invariant it protects
forbidden: Repeating SI trigger narrative without boundary semantics
Single-feature PRD scope framed as topic product architecture

presentation.guidance: Product shape content carries topic-level capability semantics; select carrier by whether partition, dependency, or cross-domain journey must be read without inference.

allowed.carrier: Capability responsibility table (capability/domain | responsibility | attachment point for future features)
Directed dependency table (dependent → coupling point → dependency)
Topic-level journey boundary view (boundary | trigger | product end-state) when cross-feature flows matter

forbidden: User-story or acceptance-criteria tables (belongs in lulu-spec)
Technical module or API tables (belongs in lulu-arch)
Decision rationale tables duplicating PR
Implementation task lists

required: Core capabilities or value domains named with responsibility boundaries at topic granularity
Future feature attachment points visible without re-deriving partitions
forbidden: Placeholder names like 'some capability' or 'related feature'
Decorative diagrams with no product semantics
Opening with decision rationale before shape is established (belongs in PR)

presentation.guidance: When multiple product paths were genuinely considered at topic level, a comparison structure carries trade-off semantics; single-path decisions may use analytical prose.

allowed.carrier: Product path comparison table (path | conclusion | trade-off rationale | reopen condition)
Analytical reasoning prose (single decision, no genuine alternatives)

forbidden: Capability layout duplicating PS
Feature acceptance matrices (belongs in lulu-spec)
Technical architecture trade-offs (belongs in lulu-arch KD)

required: Product-level trade-off reasoning beyond stakeholder authorization alone
Rejected alternatives named when genuinely considered
Reopen or evolution conditions stated when reversibility matters
forbidden: Selected direction rationale consisting solely of authorization references
Repeating BD exclusion list without decision semantics
Technical implementation tactics

presentation.guidance: Open items carry topic-level tracking semantics: assumption or risk, related product gap, and whether the next feature cycle is blocked.

allowed.carrier: Open-item tracking table (item | related gap | blocks-next-cycle or non-blocking | closure condition)

forbidden: Closed decisions restated from PR
Feature-level acceptance gaps without topic-level product impact
Technical verification matrices (belongs in lulu-arch)

required: blocks-next-cycle or non-blocking label on each item
Closure condition or resolution path when status is non-blocking
forbidden: Items that only repeat PS/PR content without unresolved assumptions
Feature-level gaps without topic-level product architecture impact
